meta.what: THE FLOOR: every quantity the agent perceives or is told, per object, per pair, per event, per board. Every library entry's `reads`/`affects` name readings from this file and nothing else. Figure 13: atoms(Γ) are the terms not built from anything else; Figure 6: an instrument is 'improved from a worse instrument already returning something'.
meta.status_values: published = on the scored path today; arm:<FLAG> = built, published only when that arm is on (default off unless noted); harness-on = turned on by arc_holdout.wire on the ARC path; queued:<branch> = built on a branch not yet merged into seat-act; planned = specified (RELATIONS.md / observer schema / rulings) and not built
meta.types: COLOUR (an episode-local label by encounter order within a spectrum band: identity/difference only, NO arithmetic, never stored across episodes -- corpus, confirmed by Isaiah 2026-10-08), POSITION (ordered), EXTENT (ordered, non-negative), DELTA (signed change), SHAPE (agent-allocated label: identity/difference only, no arithmetic -- ruling 2026-10-08), BOOL (logic only), OBJECT, PRED
meta.source: seat-act e50406d: arc_atoms.ATTRIBUTE_TYPE / ATTRIBUTE_ARM, arc_percept, arc_world, tether (came/gone); queued branches per the seat's branch map 2026-10-08
meta.self_readings: scope 'self' = the agent's own record (residual, prediction, standing, library size). Atoms about rules, beliefs and learning read these; Figure 1's loop produces them every step.
meta.generalisation: Isaiah 2026-10-08: colours change every time a game loads, and on the private (out-of-distribution) boards objects may be rearranged, the board rotated or shrunk, 'all in service of showing that you're generalising'. So no raw value crosses an episode: colour is a per-episode label (identity/difference only), positions and sizes cross only as relations between objects, and axis-dependent relations (above, left of) cross with the axis as a bound variable. Figure 4: 'A recording carried upward looks like knowledge and is a description of one occasion.' The Symbols table: T_A, abstraction, 'Detail is thrown away, which is what makes the result reusable'; F, the frame transform.
meta.code_note: 27 readings are also built as OBJECT->type extract atoms by arc_atoms._extract (one per ATTRIBUTE_TYPE row). They are PERCEPTION and are recorded HERE only, never again among the agent's operations.

colour.grid: the object's colour as an EPISODE-LOCAL LABEL: named by order of encounter within its spectrum band (GB1, GB2 ...), compared same/other only
colour.carry: never the value -- only same/other relations between objects

row.carry: never the value -- only relations (before/after/level along an axis; offsets between objects)

col.carry: never the value -- only relations (before/after/level along an axis; offsets between objects)

h.carry: never the value -- only comparisons (more/less/same) and ratios between objects

w.carry: never the value -- only comparisons (more/less/same) and ratios between objects

shape.grid: the outline's label (episode-local; compare same/other only)
shape.carry: never the label -- only same/other between objects, and invariants (holes, symmetry, corners) that survive rotation and scale

drow.grid: rows moved since the last frame (signed)
drow.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

dcol.grid: columns moved since the last frame (signed)
dcol.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

touching.grid: two objects share a cell face
touching.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

action.grid: which action the agent took this frame

press.grid: the cell a positioned action pressed, and the object under it (F509)

dh.status: arm:TETHER_OBSERVER (per-object part queued ON in seat-observer)
dh.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

dw.status: arm:TETHER_OBSERVER (per-object part queued ON in seat-observer)
dw.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

dcells.status: arm:TETHER_OBSERVER (per-object part queued ON in seat-observer)
dcells.grid: filled-cell count change since last frame
dcells.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

colour_changed.status: arm:TETHER_OBSERVER (per-object part queued ON in seat-observer)
colour_changed.grid: the object's colour differs from last frame
colour_changed.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

contact.status: arm:TETHER_OBSERVER (pair part held back: enters via the relation channel)
contact.grid: number of shared cell faces between two objects (0 corner, 1 edge, 2+ face)
contact.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

bbox.grid: area where two bounding boxes overlap
bbox.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

inside.grid: one object lies in another's hole
inside.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

dholes.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

dperimeter.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

age.grid: frames since the object was first tracked
age.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

stability.grid: consecutive frames the object has not changed
stability.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

speed.status: arm:TETHER_INSTRUMENTS -- ruled NOT a slot 2026-10-08 (a current-frame composition: larger of |drow|,|dcol|)
speed.grid: cells moved this frame (larger of the two deltas)
speed.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

filled.status: queued:seat-filled (ruled a bet-on slot 2026-10-08; identity with the `area` atom recorded, not duplicated)
filled.carry: never the value -- only comparisons (more/less/same) and ratios between objects

prev.grid: this slot's own value one frame earlier, offered as an operand (not a slot, not bet on)

add_n.grid: cells added to the object this frame
add_n.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

rem_n.grid: cells removed from the object this frame
rem_n.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

add_row.grid: centroid row of the added cells
add_row.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

add_col.grid: centroid column of the added cells
add_col.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

rem_row.grid: centroid row of the removed cells
rem_row.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

rem_col.grid: centroid column of the removed cells
rem_col.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

allowance.status: queued:seat-budget (told by the frame at game start, ruled 2026-10-08)
allowance.grid: the game's remaining search allowance, in work units

level.status: planned (the habitat reports level boundaries; reading not yet published as a slot)
level.grid: which level of the game is being played

residual.status: published (the agent's own record: R per slot, Figure 1)
residual.grid: how far this object's observed value missed the prediction

predicted.grid: the value the agent predicted for this object

standing.status: published (gamma.Standing: how often a term held vs failed)
standing.grid: how well a rule has held so far

terms.grid: how many rules the agent holds

dcompleted.status: planned -- the mutation observer's delta of this attribute (Isaiah 2026-09-15/22: every attribute's change is the cue)
dcompleted.grid: the level's progress changed this frame (rose or fell)

dcontact.status: planned -- the mutation observer's delta of this attribute (Isaiah 2026-09-15/22: every attribute's change is the cue)
dcontact.grid: two objects came into, or out of, contact this frame
dcontact.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

dinside.status: planned -- the mutation observer's delta of this attribute (Isaiah 2026-09-15/22: every attribute's change is the cue)
dinside.grid: an object entered or left another's hole this frame
dinside.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

dbbox.status: planned -- the mutation observer's delta of this attribute (Isaiah 2026-09-15/22: every attribute's change is the cue)
dbbox.grid: two bounding boxes began or stopped overlapping
dbbox.carry: relations and changes, never a raw value

dresidual.status: planned -- the mutation observer's delta of this attribute (Isaiah 2026-09-15/22: every attribute's change is the cue)
dresidual.grid: the miss on this object grew or shrank

dstanding.status: planned -- the mutation observer's delta of this attribute (Isaiah 2026-09-15/22: every attribute's change is the cue)

dterms.status: planned -- the mutation observer's delta of this attribute (Isaiah 2026-09-15/22: every attribute's change is the cue)

computed_by_agent_atoms: holes, perimeter, corners, area, bbox_area, centroid, canonical, symmetric, is_square, orbit_size, count, distinct, sum_group, rank_in, is_max, is_min, is_mode, parity, sign, abs_delta, touching_n, owner, aligned, above, same, other, rotate, reflect, translate, recolour -- these are AGENT atoms (agent_atoms.json), functions over the readings above; they are the executable PRIMITIVE layer, not readings.
